title: fix(react): a page node whose visibility predicate faults is withheld (objectui#13299)
body:
Fixes #13299
Clause-②: no

## What

A page node whose DECLARED visibility predicate faults on evaluation (over the CEL AST bound, a type error, an unbound root, a missing function) is no longer rendered. As objectui#13286 already did for a `page:tabs` item, page visibility gates now fail closed.

- `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`: `visibilityGateKind` became `visibilityFaultOutcome(key, raw)`, which answers both what a fault DECIDES on a leg and which consequence the report prints. `evaluateVisibilityPredicate` uses it in both branches. Production keeps ONE engine call: `onFault` records the fault on that call and the faulted call answers with the fail-closed verdict (no second `throwOnError` evaluation). The dev branch's `throwOnError` catch returns the same verdict. Reports go through the shared `reportUnresolvableVisibilityPredicate` and its dedupe set, with the `'withholding'` consequence on a declared SHOW-leg predicate. The docblocks that said the fail-open semantics were "not its to move" are rewritten.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`: the `page:tabs` count-probe gate `isGateOpen` mirrors the node gate (same `onFault` flag, same `hasDeclaredPredicate` test, same `'withholding'` copy), so a badge counts what is drawn.
- `content/docs/guide/metadata-diagnostics.md`: page visibility gates (node and tab item) fail closed; form field rules keep their fail-open. The node example's consequence line, which said the gate "did NOT bite", is replaced by a sentence naming what the fault does on each leg.
- `.changeset/13299-node-visibility-fail-closed.md`: patch for `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/components`.

### Every leg, and where a fault lands

| Leg | Polarity in `shouldHide` | Declared predicate faults | Blank gate (declares nothing) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `visibleWhen` | negated | `false` -> not rendered (was: shown) · copy `'withholding'` | fail-soft `true` -> shown · copy `'visibility'` |
| `visible` | negated | not rendered (was: shown) · `'withholding'` | shown · `'visibility'` |
| `visibleOn` | negated | not rendered (was: shown) · `'withholding'` | shown · `'visibility'` |
| `hidden` | not negated | `true` -> not rendered (unchanged) · `'concealment'` | never evaluated (`hasDeclaredPredicate` guard) |
| `hiddenOn` | not negated | not rendered (unchanged) · `'concealment'` | never evaluated |

`disabled` / `disabledOn` route through `evaluateEnablementPredicate`, which shares no helper with the visibility chain; they are unchanged. `hasDeclaredPredicate` is asked only on the fault path, because it reports a blank gate as a side effect and a non-faulting predicate must stay as silent as it was.

## Pins

New: `packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.nodeVisibilityFailClosed-13299.test.tsx` (rows a-d, each in the production and the development module graph) and `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-node-visibility-fail-closed-13299.test.tsx` (rows e and f).

- (a) a throwing `visibleWhen` is not rendered, and two renders log ONE warning that says WITHHELD.
- (b) `visible`, `visibleOn` (and a faulting CEL envelope on `visibleWhen`) are not rendered; `hidden`, `hiddenOn` are not rendered with the concealment copy.
- (c) CONTROL: true shows, false hides, absent shows, blank `''` and blank envelope show; no WITHHELD line.
- (d) a 120-term OR chain over the AST bound is withheld; a 4-term one shows. The `[bounds]` reason is asserted in production only: the dev `throwOnError` probe reports a generic CEL reason for the same fault (pre-existing, see Acceptance notes).
- (e) the tab badge does not count a list withheld by an unbound root, by an over-budget source, or by a faulting gate on a container above it; CONTROLS: a true gate and a blank gate are counted.
- (f) CONTROL: a form field `visibleWhen` that faults is still drawn.

### Existing fail-open pins flipped (each now asserts withheld)

`packages/react`:
- `SchemaRenderer.productionPredicateFaultWarning.test.tsx`: the seven verdict assertions in groups 1, 2 and 4 (BARE, CEL, template, three-ids, distinct-source, two-hundred-row, dev-vs-prod).
- `SchemaRenderer.concealmentGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx`: group 2 (three negated legs) now asserts withheld + the withholding clause, with the old "did NOT bite" sentence pinned absent.
- `SchemaRenderer.visibleWhenRecordBinding.test.tsx`: "binds the record ROOT only", leg 3 "warns ... and WITHHOLDS", "the bare-string dialect is loud too", the production case, and the objectui#6487 advice case.
- `SchemaRenderer.nodeGateDataPredicate.test.tsx`: 3b and 5d.
- `SchemaRenderer.dataRootUnbound-9308.test.tsx`: leg 7.
- `SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx`: the visibility-copy tail in group 4 is now the withholding paragraph.

Outside `packages/react` (the same flip, made false by this change; declared as a file-surface extension):
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-count-visible-when-12987.test.tsx`: the fail-open count case now asserts the list is not counted.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-empty-action-visible-when.test.tsx`: the faulting emptyAction is withheld.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/predicate-scope-parity-6010.test.tsx`: the FAULTED group now expects the page node closed and the four form surfaces open.
- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/hasCapability-13006.render.test.tsx`: three cases (not loaded, unreported, refused map) now withhold the node.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-alert.rowBinding.test.tsx`: group C shorthand is withheld on both rows.

## Verification (at `321c1f244d`)

- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock: react family naming `SchemaRenderer` (55 files, 893 tests) run first; the 7 react files touched re-run green (130/130); `page:tabs` family + new components file (12 files, 77/77); consumer files in app-shell / plugin-detail / components / apps/console / examples (24 files) re-run after the flips, then the four flipped ones (37/37); a wider sweep of 19 files that render `SchemaRenderer` with a gate and a fault/warn assertion (586/586).
- Type-check: closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...'` exit 0, then `type-check` (which runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for react, components, app-shell, plugin-detail: all exit 0.
- Lint narrowed to the 15 changed TS/TSX files, the way each package's `lint` script runs eslint: exit 0, 0 errors. Population: `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`; count from `--format json`; invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. Control-byte self-scan over the diff: no hits.
- Declared to CI: the full test directories of `packages/react`, `packages/components`, `packages/app-shell`, `packages/plugin-detail` (no whole-directory runs here, per the dispatch), and every other package's suite.

### Ablation (one-shot, nothing left in the tree)

Restored the fail-soft verdict on the node gate in both branches (`return fault ? fault.verdict : verdict;` to `return verdict;`, and the dev catch's `return fault.verdict;` to `return true;`) through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hits 1 -> 0 on disk for each, under a restore trap), then ran both new files: 10 failed / 12 passed. Red: (a) x2 builds, (b) `visible` / `visibleOn` / CEL envelope x2 builds, (d) x2 builds. Green: (c) x2, (f), and (b) `hidden` / `hiddenOn` x2 builds. The `hidden` / `hiddenOn` rows staying green is the expected direction, not a hole: their fail-soft `true` already hid, so the ablation does not move them. (e) stays green too because the count-probe gate is a separate site the ablation does not touch. Restore proven by blob hash: `SchemaRenderer.tsx` blob after restore = HEAD blob `e2f0700ce56e`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured behaviour shifts, all the ruled direction: a `record.*` node gate on a surface where no row is bound (including a record page before the row has loaded) is now withheld rather than shown; a `current_user.hasCapability(...)` node gate is withheld while the capability list is not loaded, and stays withheld on a backend that never reports `systemPermissions`; a row-action shorthand (`status == 'x'`, unbound since objectui#5741) withholds its node. None of these looked like essential content that needs fail-open, so no fork is reported.
- The shared `'withholding'` consequence copy in `visibilityDiagnostic.ts` was written for the app-shell navigation gate and says "a navigation entry". It now prints for page nodes (and since objectui#13286 for tab items). That file is outside this card's surface; not changed here.
- The dev branch's `throwOnError` probe reports a generic CEL reason for an over-budget source, while production's `onFault` reports the engine's `[bounds]` reason. Pre-existing; the verdict and the line count agree.
- `record:alert`'s own renderer-level `useCondition` (gate 2) is still fail-soft. End to end the node chain now withholds the shorthand case first, so it only shows when a node-level `visibleWhen` wins the chain and a faulting `properties.visible` reaches gate 2.
